game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ember furnace.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ember furnace. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the power_on value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 14.
